summary.headline: Cheil Worldwide to buy back shares worth KRW 60bn on the KOSPI market, Nov 25, 2026 to Jan 29, 2027
summary.what_happened: Cheil Worldwide Inc announced a decision on Nov 24, 2026 to acquire up to 3,291,278 ordinary shares for an expected amount of KRW 60bn through open-market purchases on the KOSPI market, with the acquisition period running from Nov 25, 2026 to Jan 29, 2027. The company stated that it plans to cancel all of the acquired shares, and three brokers (Samsung Securities, Shinhan Securities and KB Securities) will execute the purchases.

key_numbers.label: Expected number of shares to acquire

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, a share buyback with a stated plan to cancel the shares typically reduces the total number of outstanding shares, which can affect per-share metrics for existing shareholders. The actual number of shares acquired may differ from the planned figure depending on share price movements, as the filing notes.
